details.question: How many vacation days do full-time store employees receive?
details.actual_answer: 18 paid vacation days per year after completing 90 days of employment

details.question: Can store associates work remotely?
details.expected_answer: Remote work is not available for store associates
details.actual_answer: No, store associates cannot work remotely because their roles require physical store presence.

details.question: How long do customers have to return online orders?
details.actual_answer: Customers have 30 days to return online orders with proof of purchase.

details.question: What should a manager do if POS systems are offline for more than 10 minutes?
details.expected_answer: contact IT support, open an incident ticket, and switch to manual transaction logging if approved
details.actual_answer: The manager must contact IT support, open an incident ticket, and switch to manual transaction logging if approved.

details.question: What does P1 mean for incidents?
details.expected_answer: full store outage or payment processing failure
details.actual_answer: P1 means full store outage or payment processing failure.
